SHOREBREAK / VỰC LẶNG — original underwater assets

Reefbreaker shark, Abyssal Regent kraken and Abyssal Warden sea kaiju are
custom Blender models authored for this project. GLBs contain original
generated PBR textures and embedded skeleton animation. The related Blender
sources are provided separately in the creature prototype packages.

The shader caustics, seafloor, habitat props, ruins, dive bell, buoy, data
instruments, shoaling fish and UI are original procedural work in this repo.
Sound is generated through Web Audio; there are no third-party sound clips.

Three.js and GLTFLoader remain vendored under their included MIT license.
No Subnautica assets, maps, UI, audio or branded creatures are included.
Original prior surfing assets and their licenses are preserved under ../.

Model counts, embedded texture sizes and clips are recorded from actual GLB
contents in ASSET-MANIFEST.json. Those counts are not measured GPU performance.
